description: Create, update, or delete wiki pages. Actions: create (new page with title/content/format), update (modify content or title), delete (remove permanently). Related: browse_wiki to read pages.

action.description: Action to perform: create, update, delete

content.description: New content of the wiki page Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

format.description: Content format (markdown, rdoc, asciidoc, org). Defaults to markdown. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

slug.description: URL-encoded slug of the wiki page Required for 'update', 'delete' action(s).

title.description: New title of the wiki page Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

name: manage_wiki
